scope: CI registration of custom/default inf shortest-path independent regression tests

reference.method: Arbitrary-precision synchronous Bellman-Ford. A further improving edge marks negative-cycle seeds; graph reachability propagates affected vertices. Floyd-Warshall rows and Dijkstra results are compared to it; returned vertex paths are checked for endpoints, actual edges and exact total weight.
reference.port: Removed old-source conditional branches and changed includes to repo-relative paths; retained the independent algorithm, seed, cases and result digest. Added explicit standard headers.

coverage: 1500 seeded small random graphs: disconnected vertices, self-loops, multiple edges, nonnegative and signed weights, negative cycles.
Custom inf 1, 2, 7, 100, 1e12, around 2^60 and INT64_MAX; nonpositive inf throws even in skip builds.
Dijkstra adjacency and bulk-edge APIs, each with and without path output; Bellman-Ford and SPFA.
Floyd-Warshall with/without path reconstruction, including very large signed weights requiring wide arithmetic and finite-answer collisions with +/-inf.
64/65/256/257/4096/4097-vertex chains and cycles, including paths temporarily outside the output range.
Default API calls run on the same fixed graph sequence and preserve the prior default digest.
FW graph cases with input edges outside its documented (-inf,inf) domain are deliberately skipped; their output is not interpreted.

validation.configurations: GCC/Clang x checked/skip; GCC additionally standard arithmetic and SIMD disabled x checked/skip. -std=c++23 -O2 -Wall -Wextra.
validation.runtime_registration: unittest discover: 6 tests, each runs custom and default modes. All passed.
validation.diagnostics: No compiler warnings in the six explicit compiler configurations.

sanitizer: No new sanitizer or performance claim in this registration task; parent graph implementation task separately archived those results.
limitations: This is local independent verification; it does not establish online AC for changed sources.
Future Dijkstra implementation edits must rerun the registered test; hashes here identify exactly the version manually validated.
